title: Add SFTP remote file transfer functionality
author: raohj1987
body_snippet: The current SSH file transfer function is not very user-friendly. Among the remote file transfer tools I have used, Xshell provides a relatively good experience. Therefore, referring to the features of Xshell, similar functionality has been added to mRemoteNG.
